title: Tell me if I'm wrong: the best work in town loses to the guy who posts.
caption:
Tell me if I'm wrong: homeowners don't hire the best contractor. They hire the one they SAW.

You can out-work every competitor in your zip code and still lose the job to a guy with a mediocre pressure washer and a consistent feed.

AfterShot fixes the only part you're losing: you send the before and after from the truck, it renders the reel and posts it for you. Every job becomes proof.

Am I wrong? Tell me in the comments.
